title: A documented shared logging allocation
method: Synthetic $2,400 pool allocated 50/30/20 by ingested byte share. Allocations reconcile to the pool. Retention and query costs are not separately modeled; a real policy may need different drivers.
alt: A documented shared logging allocation. Team A: 1200 USD; Team B: 720 USD; Team C: 480 USD. Illustrative values.
